_comment: COMMITTED CONTRACT for assets/assets.manifest.json — documentation only.
Nothing reads this file; it exists so the manifest's shape is reviewable in
git while the real artifact is not. Same split as .env.example vs .env.
The real manifest is GENERATED by `make assets-sync` (or as a side effect of
`make post-infra`) and is gitignored: every value in it is
environment-specific. The URLs below are the LOCAL (Floci) path-style form;
a production run produces different ones for the same keys — eventually a
CloudFront domain rather than the bucket itself.
Consumers read `assets[<key>].url` and MUST also set width/height explicitly
on the tag: Outlook (Word rendering engine) ignores CSS sizing, so the
dimensions are carried here rather than left for the template to assume.
